title: Sequin Tulle Ruffle Sleeve Maxi Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shimmer and shine in this dazzling evening dress! Featuring sparkling sequins and elegant ruffle sleeves, this stunning piece flaunts a figure-flattering silhouette perfect for formal events, galas, or special nights out. Get ready to turn heads and steal the spotlight!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequins.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
